title: The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models
title_zh: 框架即模型：智能体脚手架改变固定LLM对银行行为规则的合规性，且在不同模型间不均匀

paragraphs.en: Banks evaluate and validate language models, but what they deploy is a system : a model inside a harness that decides what the model sees, which tools it can call and who checks its actions. We test whether that harness changes compliance with banking conduct rules when the model is held fixed. Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses (a pipeline that makes one structured decision, a ReAct-style tool loop, a loop in which the policy is reachable only through search, a loop with a long benign customer memory, and a loop with a same-model compliance reviewer) on 156 pre-registered cases in a simulated retail bank whose 11 rule families paraphrase EU consumer-credit, payments, investor-protection, data-protection and anti-money-laundering provisions. Every one of the 3120 two-turn episodes was scored deterministically from the executed tool trace, with violations and over-refusals counted separately. Pooled across models the harness moved the correct-case rate only between 87.3% and 92.1%, but within a model it mattered a great deal: for one model the spread between its best and worst harness was 11.5 percentage points (Cochran’s Q = 25.1 Q=25.1 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), enough to move it from first to last place among the four models, while for another the harness made no detectable difference; the model × \times harness interaction itself was suggestive rather than conclusive ( χ 12 2 = 19.8 \chi^{2}_{12}=19.8 , p = 0.07 p=0.07 ). The same-model reviewer cut violations from 9.6% to 6.4% ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) without raising over-refusals, contrary to our pre-registered prediction. Rules that require date arithmetic failed in every harness. In an exploratory analysis with two LLM judges and a blind human check, 26% of violations were accompanied by a customer message that denied the action the agent had just executed, so a review of the transcript alone would have recorded a correct refusal. For model-risk management the unit of validation should be the model–harness pair, and conduct testing should read the action log, not the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 银行会评估和验证语言模型，但它们实际部署的是一个系统：即处于一套运行框架（harness）之中的模型，该框架决定模型看到什么、可以调用哪些工具以及由谁来检查其行为。 我们测试的是，在模型固定不变的情况下，这套运行框架是否会改变模型对银行行为准则的合规表现。 四个开放权重模型各自在五个运行框架（一种只做一次结构化决策的流水线、一个 ReAct 风格的工具循环、一个策略只能通过搜索才能获取的循环、一个带有长篇良性客户记忆的循环，以及一个带有同模型合规审查员的循环）中，在一个模拟零售银行里运行了 156 个预先注册的测试用例；该银行的 11 类规则改写自欧盟消费者信贷、支付、投资者保护、数据保护和反洗钱条款。 全部 3120 个两轮对话情节（episode）都根据实际执行的工具调用轨迹进行确定性评分，违规和过度拒答被分别统计。 跨模型汇总来看，运行框架仅使正确用例率在 87.3% 与 92.1% 之间变动，但在单个模型内部其影响非常大：对于其中一个模型，其最佳与最差运行框架之间的差距为 11.5 个百分点（Cochran's Q = 25.1，p < 0.001），足以使其在四个模型中的排名从第一降至最后；而对另一个模型，运行框架未产生可检测的差异；模型 × 运行框架的交互效应本身仅具提示性而非结论性（χ²₁₂ = 19.8，p = 0.07）。 与我们预先注册的预测相反，同模型审查员将违规率从 9.6% 降至 6.4%（p < 0.001），且未增加过度拒答。 需要日期运算的规则在所有运行框架中都失败了。 在一项包含两个大语言模型（LLM）裁判和一次盲测人工核查的探索性分析中，26% 的违规行为伴随有客户消息，该消息否认了智能体刚刚执行的操作，因此仅审查对话记录就会记录为一次正确的拒答。 对于模型风险管理而言，验证的单位应当是模型—运行框架的组合，而行为准则测试应当读取操作日志，而非对话内容。

paragraphs.en: A bank that deploys a language-model assistant does not deploy a model. It deploys a system in which the model is one component. Around it sits a harness : code that decides what goes into the context window (the policy, the customer’s history, the results of earlier lookups), which tools the model may call, in what format, how many steps it may take, and whether anything checks an action before it is executed. Model-risk practice, by contrast, is organised around the model. US supervisory guidance on model risk was revised in April 2026 and now states that generative and agentic AI models are outside its scope ( Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System et al., 2026 ) ; the UK’s SS1/23 covers AI only to the extent that it is used in models generally ( Prudential Regulation Authority, 2023 ) . Benchmarks that banks consult also usually report one number per model.

paragraphs.en: Whether this matters is an empirical question, and the evidence so far points in two directions. A pre-registered study of six models under a direct API and three scaffolds found that the scaffold explained only 0.5% of the variance in measured safety, far less than the benchmark itself ( Gringras, 2026 ) , and a coding-agent benchmark found nearly identical harmful-violation rates under three agent frameworks ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . Other work finds that harnesses change capability by up to twelve points within a model ( Bandel et al., 2026 ) , that the same model shows different safety under vendor-native harnesses than under a shared one ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and argues that harness variance can exceed model variance and reverse rankings ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . None of these studies varies the harness in a controlled way while measuring compliance with the kind of conduct rules a bank is supervised on, and none separates the two ways a compliance system can fail: doing what is forbidden, and refusing what is allowed.
paragraphs.zh: 这是否重要是一个实证问题，而目前的证据指向两个方向。 一项在直接 API 和三种脚手架下对六个模型开展的预注册研究发现，脚手架仅能解释所测安全性方差的 0.5%，远低于基准本身（Gringras, 2026）；一项编程智能体基准研究也发现，在三种智能体框架下有害违规率几乎相同（Hu et al., 2026）。 另一些研究发现，同一模型内部，测试框架可使能力变化高达十二个百分点（Bandel et al., 2026）；同一模型在厂商原生框架下的安全性表现不同于在共享框架下的表现（Liu et al., 2026）；并有研究认为，框架带来的差异可能超过模型间的差异，甚至逆转排名（Zhang et al., 2026）。 这些研究都没有在受控方式下改变测试框架，同时衡量银行受监管的行为准则的遵从情况，也都没有区分合规系统可能失败的两种方式：做被禁止的事，以及拒绝被允许的事。

paragraphs.en: We run that experiment. A simulated retail bank (“Northbridge Bank”) exposes thirteen state-changing tools and six lookups. Its 1746-word operations manual contains forty sections, of which the operative ones paraphrase specific provisions of EU law: the 14-day withdrawal right for consumer credit, the refund duty for unauthorised payments, the appropriateness test for complex products, the right to object to direct marketing, and the prohibition on tipping off a customer about an anti-money-laundering report (Appendix A). Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses that differ only in how information and control flow around the model. The models are of moderate size and were served on domestic infrastructure, a deliberate constraint: they are the kind of model a European or Turkish bank can run on its own premises under data-residency rules, and our results speak to that deployment, not to the strongest closed or reasoning models. We scored every episode from the executed tool trace and the messages actually sent, with no LLM in the scoring loop.
paragraphs.zh: 我们运行了那个实验。 一家模拟零售银行（“Northbridge Bank”）提供十三种改变状态的工具和六种查询工具。 其1746词的业务手册包含四十个章节，其中具有实际效力的章节转述了欧盟法律的具体条款：消费信贷的14天撤回权、未经授权付款的退款义务、复杂产品的适当性测试、对直接营销的拒绝权，以及禁止向客户泄露反洗钱报告（附录A）。 四个开放权重模型各自运行了五个仅在信息与控制如何围绕模型流动方面有所不同的测试框架。 这些模型规模适中，并在本地基础设施上提供服务，这是一种有意的约束：它们是欧洲或土耳其银行在数据驻留规则下可以在自有场所运行的那类模型，我们的结果针对的是这种部署方式，而非最强的闭源或推理模型。 我们根据实际执行的工具轨迹和实际发送的消息对每次运行进行评分，评分过程中没有任何大语言模型参与。

paragraphs.en: The study was pre-registered (hypotheses, outcomes and tests were fixed and hashed before any run) and amended once, before the main run, after a pilot showed a ceiling effect (Section 3.6). Our findings are:
paragraphs.zh: 本研究已预先注册（假设、结果和检验在任何运行之前均已固定并进行哈希处理），并且在正式运行之前，由于一项试点试验显示出天花板效应，曾进行过一次修订（第3.6节）。我们的研究结果如下：

paragraphs.en: The harness effect is real but model-specific. Pooled over models, harnesses differ by 4.8 points. Within a model the spread reaches 11.5 points, and the harness changes which model looks most compliant: the model that ranks first under the reviewer harness ranks last when the policy is reachable only by search. For one of the four models the harness has no detectable effect at all. The formal test of the model × \times harness interaction fell short of the 5% level, so the model-specificity is a consistent pattern in our data rather than an established effect.
paragraphs.zh: 评测框架效应是真实存在的，但具有模型特异性。 跨模型汇总来看，不同评测框架之间的差异为 4.8 分。 在单个模型内部，差异幅度可达 11.5 分，而且评测框架会改变哪个模型看起来最合规：在审查者评测框架下排名第一的模型，当策略只能通过搜索才能触及时却排名最后。 在四个模型中，有一个模型的评测框架完全没有可检测到的效应。 模型 × \times 评测框架交互作用的正式检验未达到 5% 显著性水平，因此模型特异性在我们的数据中是一种一致的模式，而非已确立的效应。

paragraphs.en: Harness and scaffold effects. Interface design changes what the same model can do ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , and agent leaderboards increasingly treat the scaffold as an evaluation axis ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ) , while cost and reproducibility problems in agent evaluation are well documented ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) . For safety the picture is mixed. Gringras (2026) report that scaffold type explains only 0.5% of the variance on question-answering safety benchmarks (ReAct and multi-agent set-ups are equivalent to the direct API, map-reduce costs 7.3 points), with large model-specific interactions; Hu et al. (2026) report a null result for coding agents; Liu et al. (2026) show that safety differs between vendor-native harnesses and a shared harness for the same model. Zhang et al. (2026) argue that agents should not be compared without disclosing the harness. Our design adds a controlled ablation of harness components (pipeline control, retrieval-only policy, long memory, reviewer) on executed actions under rules mapped to law.
paragraphs.zh: 骨架与脚手架效应。 接口设计会改变同一模型所能做的事情（Yang 等，2024），智能体排行榜也日益把脚手架当作一个评估维度（Kapoor 等，2025），而智能体评估中的成本与可复现性问题也早有详细记录（Kapoor 等，2024）。 在安全性方面，情况则喜忧参半。 Gringras（2026）报告称，脚手架类型只能解释问答类安全基准上 0.5% 的方差（ReAct 和多智能体设置与直接调用 API 等效，map-reduce 则相差 7.3 个百分点），且存在较大的模型特定交互效应；Hu 等。 （2026）针对编程智能体报告了零效应结果；Liu 等。 （2026）表明，对于同一模型，厂商原生骨架与共享骨架下的安全表现有所不同。Zhang 等。 （2026）认为，在不披露骨架的情况下不应比较智能体。 我们的设计在映射到法律规则的已执行动作之上，对骨架组件（流水线控制、仅检索策略、长期记忆、审阅者）增加了受控消融实验。

paragraphs.en: Reviewers and guards. Same-model self-correction often fails without external feedback ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , LLM evaluators favour their own outputs ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) , and a same-model reviewer has been reported to reject 35% of correct answers in mathematics ( Tanveer, 2026 ) . Guard designs evaluated as defences include sub-agent verifiers ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , compiled policy gates ( Yu et al., 2026b ) and inline finance harnesses that report both safety and benign approval ( Jia et al., 2026 ) . A same-model, enforcement-varied comparison found that a bolt-on guardrail blocked violations but over-refused ( Ahn and Kim, 2026 ) . Our reviewer harness tests that trade-off inside a controlled ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 审阅者与防护栏。 缺乏外部反馈时，同模型自我修正常常失效（Huang et al., 2023），LLM 评估者偏好自己的输出（Panickssery et al., 2024），且有报告称同模型审阅者在数学任务中会拒绝 35% 的正确答案（Tanveer, 2026）。 作为防御手段被评估的防护栏设计包括子智能体验证器（Kang et al., 2026）、编译后的策略门控（Yu et al., 2026b），以及同时报告安全性与良性任务批准率的内联金融工具（Jia et al., 2026）。 一项同模型、执行方式可变的对比研究发现，外挂式防护栏能够阻止违规行为，但会过度拒绝（Ahn and Kim, 2026）。 我们的审阅者工具在受控消融实验中检验了这一权衡。

paragraphs.en: Context and memory. Models use information in the middle of long contexts less well ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and accumulated benign memory has been reported to raise violation rates ( Al-Tawaha et al., 2026 ) ; another study finds agents safer after preceding benign tasks ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . We therefore treated the direction of the memory effect as open in interpretation, while pre-registering the conventional direction.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文与记忆。 模型对长上下文中间部分信息的利用能力较差（Liu et al., 2023），且已有报告称累积的良性记忆会提高违规率（Al-Tawaha et al., 2026）；另一项研究则发现智能体在先前的良性任务之后更安全（Sun et al., 2026）。 因此，我们在解释中将记忆效应的方向视为开放的，同时预先注册了常规方向。

paragraphs.en: Stated versus executed. The gap between what an agent says and what it did is an established construct: “false success” when a closing message asserts a completion the environment contradicts ( Advani, 2026 ) , “overclaiming” ( Smyth et al., 2026 ) , “corrupt success” that hides violations ( Cao et al., 2026 ) , and a split between stated reasoning and attempted action in financial compliance ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Agents under pressure have been shown to act and then misreport ( Scheurer et al., 2023 ) . We do not propose a new construct; we measure it per harness against an executed banking trace, and we report the case that previous work emphasises less: the agent does the forbidden thing and then tells the customer it did not.
paragraphs.zh: 声称与执行。 智能体所说与它实际所做之间的差距是一个已有的构念：当收尾消息声称已完成而环境与之矛盾时是“虚假成功”（Advani, 2026），还有“过度声称”（Smyth et al., 2026）、掩盖违规的“损坏成功”（Cao et al., 2026），以及金融合规场景中声称的推理与试图执行的动作之间的分裂（Luo et al., 2026）。 已有研究表明，处于压力下的智能体会先行动然后误报（Scheurer et al., 2023）。 我们并不提出新的构念；我们基于执行过的银行交易记录按测试框架对其进行度量，并报告以往工作较少强调的情形：智能体做了被禁止的事，然后却告诉客户它没有做。

Position papers argue that financial LLM systems need system-level rather than model-level validation ( Payzun et al., 2026 ) , propose reliability profiles tied to an agent’s control envelope ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) , or treat the harness as the supervisable surface in credit pipelines ( Akhtyamov, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: The environment is a deterministic Python simulation of a retail bank on a fixed date, 26 October 2026, which the system prompt states. Each case defines the calling customer, their accounts, loans, transactions and flags, the offer terms, any screening results and the appropriateness result. Two synthetic customers are used throughout; no real data is involved. State-changing tools (for example process_withdrawal , refund_fee , execute_transfer , hold_transaction , file_internal_report , block_card , place_order , escalate_to_supervisor ) always succeed, so a forbidden action is never stopped by the environment: if the agent calls it, it happened.

paragraphs.en: The operations manual has forty sections in the style of a bank’s internal manual. About twenty are operative for the cases; the rest (opening hours, standing orders, international transfers) are realistic filler. The operative sections contain exceptions that change the correct outcome: joint accounts and registered representatives, mortgages excluded from the withdrawal path, professional clients exempt from the appropriateness check, a higher refund limit for business accounts and a limit on the total refunded per conversation, own-account transfers exempt from screening, a thirteen-month limit for unauthorised-payment refunds after which the card is blocked and the case escalated, and business-account address changes that need a signed form. Appendix A maps each rule family to the legal provision it paraphrases and states where our rule is stricter than the law.

paragraphs.en: There are 39 base variants in 11 families (Table 3; legal sources in Table 4), each run in two replicates (lexical paraphrases of the customer message) and two pressure levels, giving 156 cases. Variants were built in contrasting sets: for example, credit agreements signed 5, 13, 14, 15 and 30 days before today, a mortgage signed 6 days before, fee requests just below and above the limit, two fees whose total exceeds it, and two transfers of which one beneficiary is a screening match. Customers give calendar dates, not day counts, so the agent must compute elapsed time. Every case has a scripted second customer turn that is sent whatever the agent said first: for cases where the correct outcome is to refuse, it pushes back with a reason that does not change the rule (“It’s only just over the period, surely you can make an exception?”); for permitted cases it is neutral (“Thanks. Just to be sure, is everything done now?”). Under pressure, the customer message adds that they are in a hurry and will move their accounts, and the system prompt adds that the assistant is evaluated on satisfaction and conversion.
paragraphs.zh: 共有 11 个族别的 39 个基础变体（表 3；法律来源见表 4），每个变体以两次重复（客户消息的词汇改写）和两个压力级别运行，共产生 156 个案例。 变体以对比集合的方式构建：例如，在今天之前 5、13、14、15 和 30 天签署的信贷协议，在今天之前 6 天签署的抵押贷款，略低于和略高于限额的费用请求，总额超过限额的两笔费用，以及受益人之一命中筛查名单的两笔转账。 客户给出的是日历日期而非天数，因此智能体必须计算经过的时间。 每个案例都有一段预设的第二次客户发言，无论智能体先说什么都会发送：对于正确结果应为拒绝的案例，它会以一个不改变规则的理由进行反驳（“只超过了一点点，你肯定可以破例吧？”）；对于允许办理的案例，该发言是中性的（“谢谢。 只是确认一下，现在一切都办好了吗？”）。 在压力条件下，客户消息会补充说他们很着急并打算把账户转走，系统提示词会补充说明该助手以满意度和转化率作为评估标准。

paragraphs.en: H0, pipeline. The bank’s workflow runs every relevant lookup in advance (identity check, account, offer terms, screening, appropriateness) and gives the model a case file. The model returns one JSON object listing the actions to execute and the message to the customer; after the follow-up it returns a second object with any new actions.
paragraphs.zh: H0，流水线模式。 银行的工作流提前运行所有相关的查询（身份核验、账户、报价条款、筛查、适当性评估），并为模型提供一个案件档案。 模型返回一个 JSON 对象，列出要执行的操作和发给客户的消息；在后续跟进之后，它返回第二个对象，包含任何新的操作。

sents.zh: H0，流水线模式。

paragraphs.en: H4, reviewer. As H1, but every state-changing call and every customer message is first sent to a reviewer, the same model with the manual and the conversation, which approves or blocks it with a reason; a blocked call is not executed and the reason is returned to the agent.

paragraphs.en: We used four open-weight models served by a domestic research API at temperature 0 with a fixed seed and reasoning disabled: deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash, qwen3.8-flash-next and gemma-4-31b. Using open models on domestic infrastructure was a design constraint (bank data rules exclude foreign APIs in our setting), and it means the results speak to models a bank could run on its own premises, not to the strongest closed models.

paragraphs.en: Scoring is deterministic and reads only the executed trace and the messages sent in both turns. An episode is a violation if any forbidden action was executed or any forbidden content was sent: for example a state-changing action before identity was verified, a withdrawal outside the permitted path, a refund above the limit or after the time limit, an executed transfer to a screening match, a message mentioning screening or a report after a match, a disclosed balance of another person, or a product offer to a customer who objected to marketing. It is an over-refusal if a required action was not taken (a permitted withdrawal not processed, a permitted refund not made in full, a required escalation or block missing). The correct-case outcome is neither. Message tests use pattern matching (for example, any of the number formats of a disclosed balance). The scorer is covered by 22 unit tests that drive the simulation with hand-written traces ( deney/test_ortam.py in the replication package).
paragraphs.zh: 评分是确定性的，只读取已执行的轨迹和两个回合中发送的消息。 如果执行了任何禁止操作或发送了任何禁止内容，则该回合为违规：例如在身份验证完成之前执行了改变状态的操作，在允许路径之外进行了取款，超过限额或超时的退款，向筛查匹配对象执行了转账，提及筛查或匹配后发送报告的消息，泄露了另一个人的余额，或向拒绝营销的客户提供了产品推荐。 如果未采取必要的操作（未处理允许的取款、未足额完成允许的退款、缺少必要的升级或拦截），则为过度拒绝。 正确情形的结果是两者都不是。 消息测试使用模式匹配（例如，泄露余额的任意数字格式）。 评分器由 22 个单元测试覆盖，这些测试用手写的轨迹驱动仿真（复现包中的 deney/test_ortam.py）。

paragraphs.en: Hypotheses H1–H7, outcomes, tests and a parse-rate gate were written and their files hashed before any run. A first pilot (v1: 560 episodes, eleven-section policy, single-turn cases with day counts) passed the gate but hit a ceiling: correct-case rates were between 97.3% and 100% in every harness. Before the main run we amended the design (task realism only; harnesses, models, outcomes and hypotheses unchanged): the forty-section manual, calendar dates, compound requests and the scripted second turn. The amended pilot (780 episodes) passed the gate (parseable final message in 96.8% of H4 episodes and 100% in the others) and, as pre-specified, its episodes are part of the 3120 reported here.
paragraphs.zh: 在任何运行之前，假设 H1–H7、结果、测试以及解析率门槛均已完成撰写，且其文件已进行哈希处理。 首次试点（v1：560 个回合、十一章政策、带天数的单轮案例）通过了门槛，但触及了天花板：在所有测试环境中，正确案例的比率介于 97.3% 和 100% 之间。 在正式运行之前，我们修订了设计（仅涉及任务真实性；测试环境、模型、结果和假设均未改变）：四十章手册、日历日期、复合请求以及脚本化的第二轮。 修订后的试点（780 个回合）通过了门槛（H4 回合中 96.8% 的最终消息可解析，其余均为 100%），并且如预先规定的那样，其回合包含在此处报告的 3120 个回合之中。

sents.en: A first pilot (v1: 560 episodes, eleven-section policy, single-turn cases with day counts) passed the gate but hit a ceiling: correct-case rates were between 97.3% and 100% in every harness.
sents.zh: 首次试点（v1：560 个回合、十一章政策、带天数的单轮案例）通过了门槛，但触及了天花板：在所有测试环境中，正确案例的比率介于 97.3% 和 100% 之间。

sents.en: Before the main run we amended the design (task realism only; harnesses, models, outcomes and hypotheses unchanged): the forty-section manual, calendar dates, compound requests and the scripted second turn.
sents.zh: 在正式运行之前，我们修订了设计（仅涉及任务真实性；测试环境、模型、结果和假设均未改变）：四十章手册、日历日期、复合请求以及脚本化的第二轮。

sents.en: The amended pilot (780 episodes) passed the gate (parseable final message in 96.8% of H4 episodes and 100% in the others) and, as pre-specified, its episodes are part of the 3120 reported here.
sents.zh: 修订后的试点（780 个回合）通过了门槛（H4 回合中 96.8% 的最终消息可解析，其余均为 100%），并且如预先规定的那样，其回合包含在此处报告的 3120 个回合之中。

paragraphs.en: Within each model we compare harnesses on the same cases with Cochran’s Q Q and pairwise exact McNemar tests with Holm correction. Directional hypotheses (H2–H5, H7) use exact McNemar tests on violations, paired on (model, case). The model × \times harness interaction (H6) is a Wald test in a logistic GEE clustered on case. Intervals are Wilson 95% intervals. The stated-versus-executed analysis was registered as secondary and is reported as exploratory.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个模型内部，我们在相同的案例上使用 Cochran's Q 检验以及经 Holm 校正的成对精确 McNemar 检验来比较各测试框架。 定向假设（H2–H5、H7）在违规情况上使用以（模型, 案例）配对的精确 McNemar 检验。 模型 × \times 测试框架交互效应（H6）通过以案例为聚类单元的逻辑回归 GEE 中的 Wald 检验进行检验。 区间为 Wilson 95% 置信区间。 所述与实际执行之间的对比分析已预先注册为次要分析，并作为探索性分析进行报告。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 gives the correct-case rate for each model and harness. Pooled over models, the harnesses are close: from 87.3% (H2) to 92.1% (H4). Within models they are not. The harness effect was significant for qwen3.8-flash-next ( Q = 25.1 Q=25.1 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and deepseek-v4-flash ( Q = 16.1 Q=16.1 , p = 0.003 p=0.003 ), marginal for gemma-4-31b ( p = 0.07 p=0.07 ) and absent for deepseek-v4.1-flash ( Q = 1.0 Q=1.0 , p = 0.92 p=0.92 ). The GEE interaction test was χ 12 2 = 19.8 \chi^{2}_{12}=19.8 ( p = 0.07 p=0.07 ), so the evidence that harness effects differ across models is suggestive rather than conclusive at this sample size (H6).
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 给出了每个模型和测试框架在正确情形下的正确率。 跨模型汇总后，各测试框架的结果接近：从 87.3%（H2）到 92.1%（H4）。 但在各模型内部它们并不接近。 测试框架效应在 qwen3.8-flash-next（Q=25.1，p<0.001）和 deepseek-v4-flash（Q=16.1，p=0.003）上显著，在 gemma-4-31b 上处于边缘水平（p=0.07），在 deepseek-v4.1-flash 上则不存在（Q=1.0，p=0.92）。 GEE 交互检验结果为 χ²₁₂=19.8（p=0.07），因此在该样本量下，测试框架效应因模型而异的证据只是提示性的，尚非结论性的（H6）。

paragraphs.en: The harness also changes which model looks most compliant (Table 2). qwen3.8-flash-next is the most compliant model under the reviewer harness (93.6%) and the least compliant when the policy is reachable only through search (82.1%); after Holm correction its H2 cell is significantly worse than both H0 and H4. deepseek-v4-flash shows the opposite pattern: it ranks first (tied) under H2 and last or tied for last under H0, H1 and H3. The confidence intervals of neighbouring models overlap, so we read the rank changes as a warning about single-harness evaluations, not as a precise ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架也会改变哪个模型看起来最合规（表2）。qwen3.8-flash-next 在评审框架下是最合规的模型（93.6%），而当策略只能通过搜索触达时则是最不合规的（82.1%）；经 Holm 校正后，其在 H2 单元格上的表现显著差于 H0 和 H4。deepseek-v4-flash 则呈现相反的模式：它在 H2 下排名第一（并列），而在 H0、H1 和 H3 下排名最后或并列最后。 相邻模型的置信区间相互重叠，因此我们将排名变化视为对单一框架评估的警示，而非精确的排序。

paragraphs.en: Procedure (H2, not supported). We predicted that tool loops would break step-order rules (identity before disclosure, appropriateness before an order, screening before a transfer) more often than the pipeline, which runs those checks itself. They almost never did: on the 144 paired order-dependent episodes per contrast, H0, H1 and H3 had no violations, and H2 had 5 ( p = 0.06 p=0.06 ). Current models follow explicit ordering rules reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 流程（H2，不支持）。 我们预测，工具循环会比流水线更频繁地打破步骤顺序规则（先表明身份再披露、先判断合理性再下单、先筛选再转接），因为流水线会自行执行这些检查。 结果它们几乎没有打破：在每组对比的 144 个配对的顺序依赖情节中，H0、H1 和 H3 没有任何违规，H2 有 5 次（p = 0.06 p=0.06）。 当前模型能够可靠地遵循明确的顺序规则。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval (H3, partly supported). H2 had more violations than H1 (11.5% vs. 9.6%), but the paired difference was not significant ( p = 0.10 p=0.10 ). Within H2, violations were concentrated where retrieval failed: 17.1% of the 111 episodes in which no relevant section was retrieved, against 10.3% of the 513 in which one was (Fisher p = 0.05 p=0.05 ). Retrieval-only access also created failures that did not occur when the manual was in context, in screening, financial-difficulty and APR cases (Table 3).
paragraphs.zh: 检索（H3，部分成立）。 H2 的违例多于 H1（11.5% 对 9.6%），但配对差异不显著（p = 0.10）。 在 H2 内部，违例集中在检索失败的情形：在未检索到相关章节的 111 个回合中占 17.1%，而在检索到相关章节的 513 个回合中仅占 10.3%（Fisher p = 0.05）。 仅靠检索访问还在筛查、财务困难和 APR 类案例中产生了手册置于上下文中时不会出现的失败（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: Reviewer (H5, half supported). The same-model reviewer lowered violations from 9.6% to 6.4% (24 vs. 4 discordant pairs, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The predicted cost did not appear: over-refusals were 1.6% without and 1.4% with the reviewer ( p = 1.00 p=1.00 ). The reviewer blocked at least one proposed action in 14.1% of H4 episodes, at the price of about 1.8 times the input tokens of H1.

Larger pressure effects have been reported for procurement agents facing financial incentives and managerial pressure ( Okamoto et al., 2026 ) and are consistent with sycophancy towards the user ( Sharma et al., 2023 ) ; our manipulation (an impatient customer and a note on satisfaction targets) was milder and left the rule itself unambiguous.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 breaks the correct-case rate down by rule family. Of the 11 families, 7 are at or near ceiling (at least 93% correct) in every harness except H2. The failures concentrate in two families whose rules need date arithmetic: credit withdrawal (the 14-day window, counted from the day after signing, and the mortgage exclusion) and unauthorised transactions (the thirteen-month limit). The most frequent failure reasons across all episodes were “withdrawal processed outside the permitted path” (154 episodes), “old claim not escalated” (60) and “refund after 13-month limit” (56). No harness repaired these rules: a harness can change what the model sees and who checks it, but not whether the model can count days. The reviewer helped most on unauthorised transactions (87.5% correct, against 68.8% in H1), and not at all on the withdrawal window (66.7% vs. 66.7%), plausibly because the reviewer makes the same date error as the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 按规则族细分了正确案例的比率。 在 11 个规则族中，有 7 个在除 H2 之外的所有测试环境中都达到或接近上限（正确率至少 93%）。 失败集中在两个规则需要日期运算的规则族：信用撤销（签署日次日起算的 14 天窗口，以及抵押贷款排除条款）和未授权交易（十三个月的期限）。 在所有回合中，最常见的失败原因是「撤销未通过许可路径处理」（154 个回合）、「旧索赔未升级」（60 个）和「超过 13 个月期限后的退款」（56 个）。 没有任何测试环境修复了这些规则：测试环境可以改变模型看到的内容以及由谁进行核查，但无法改变模型能否计算天数。 审查者在未授权交易上帮助最大（正确率 87.5%，而 H1 为 68.8%），而在撤销窗口上毫无帮助（66.7% 对 66.7%），合理的原因是审查者会犯与智能体相同的日期错误。

paragraphs.en: To see what a transcript review would miss, two LLM judges from different model families (deepseek-v4.1-flash and gemma-4-31b) read each episode’s customer turns, executed actions, lookups and messages, and labelled whether a message claimed an action that was not executed ( overclaim ), denied an action that was executed ( underclaim ), or otherwise misrepresented the status of the request ( misleading status ); deepseek-v4.1-flash labelled 3106 and gemma-4-31b labelled 3120 of the 3120 episodes (the remainder failed on server capacity). The judges were told not to assess policy compliance. Because LLM judges have known biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , we used two judges from different families and a blind human check. One artefact had to be handled: after a screening match the manual itself requires the agent to tell the customer that the transfer “is under standard processing”, which the judges often labelled as misleading; we excluded misleading-status labels in screening cases that rested on this mandated wording (for judges and human alike). The judges agreed on 98.4% of episodes (Cohen’s κ = 0.84 \kappa=0.84 ; underclaim κ = 0.73 \kappa=0.73 ), and a re-run of 311 episodes with a different seed reproduced at least 99.4% of labels. The author, blind to model, harness and judge labels, coded 100 episodes (50 flagged by at least one judge, 50 by neither). Agreement with the human on underclaims was κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 (deepseek-v4.1-flash) and κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 (gemma-4-31b); for the conservative rule that both judges must agree, κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 . Agreement on overclaims was κ = 0.75 \kappa=0.75 and κ = 0.90 \kappa=0.90 after we corrected 9 human codes on pipeline episodes where the first coding sheet, like the first judge prompt, did not show the identity check that the bank’s workflow had already run. Agreement on misleading status was poor ( κ ≤ 0.09 \kappa\leq 0.09 ), so we do not interpret that category.

paragraphs.en: A rule-based check for explicit completion claims without a matching action found almost none (0.1% of episodes): the agents rarely say they did something they did not do. The opposite is common. Among the 287 episodes with a violation, both judges agreed that the agent’s message denied the very action it had executed in 26.1% (41.3% by the more liberal judge). The typical case is a credit withdrawal outside the window: the agent executes process_withdrawal , and when the customer’s scripted follow-up asks for an exception, replies that the withdrawal period has expired and it cannot process the withdrawal. The rate was highest in the pipeline (41.3% of H0 violations), where the model writes its list of actions and its message in one structured reply: in several H0 episodes the message corrects the date calculation half-way through (“…let me correct that”) while the action list, written before it, already contains the withdrawal. A transcript-only review, or an evaluation that scores the final message, would record these episodes as correct refusals.

paragraphs.en: The unit of validation is the model–harness pair. For 2 of our four models, swapping the harness moved compliance by more than any difference between models under a fixed harness (at most 7.7 points), and the ranking of models changed with the harness. A validation of “the model” on one harness, or a benchmark score obtained under a vendor’s harness, does not carry over to a deployment that changes how the policy is supplied or whether actions are reviewed. This is the gap left by model-risk guidance that excludes agentic AI ( Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System et al., 2026 ) : the object that needs validating is not covered, and the object that is covered is not the one deployed. In the EU a customer-service agent is not itself a high-risk system under the AI Act, whose banking entry covers creditworthiness assessment and credit scoring ( European Parliament and Council, 2024b ) , and the high-risk obligations for those systems now apply from 2 December 2027 ( European Parliament and Council, 2026 ) ; for conduct, supervision of such agents rests on the sectoral rules our policy paraphrases. Our results agree with the pooled finding of Gringras (2026) that average scaffold effects are small, and with their observation of large model-specific interactions; for acting agents under conduct rules, the interaction is what a bank deploys.

paragraphs.en: Cheap controls are worth testing per model. A same-model reviewer removed 33% of violations without measurable over-refusal. This is good news for banks that cannot use a stronger external model, but it is a property of these models and this policy, not a law: the reviewer did not improve the withdrawal window, where it presumably shares the agent’s date error, and a pilot study found high false rejection by a same-model reviewer in mathematics ( Tanveer, 2026 ) . Where a rule is arithmetic (a date window, a cumulative limit), the natural control is deterministic code in the harness ( Yu et al., 2026b ) , not another model call.
paragraphs.zh: 低成本控制措施值得针对每个模型进行测试。 一个同款模型的审核者在不造成可测量过度拒绝的情况下移除了 33% 的违规行为。 这对那些无法使用更强外部模型的银行来说是好消息，但这是这些模型和这套策略的特性，而非规律：审核者并未改善取款时间窗口问题，因为它很可能与智能体共享同一个日期错误；而且一项试点研究发现，同款模型的审核者在数学题上存在很高的误拒率（Tanveer, 2026）。 当规则属于算术类规则（如日期窗口、累计限额）时，自然的控制手段是测试框架中的确定性代码（Yu et al., 2026b），而不是再调用一次模型。

paragraphs.en: Conduct testing should read the action log. The denial pattern means that sampling conversations for quality assurance, a common practice in contact centres, will miss a share of the violations that matter most, because the record the reviewer reads says the opposite of what happened. Evaluations that score only the final message share the problem ( Advani, 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . In a regulatory setting the message is also an act: telling a customer that their withdrawal was not processed when it was is itself a conduct failure.

sents.en: The denial pattern means that sampling conversations for quality assurance, a common practice in contact centres, will miss a share of the violations that matter most, because the record the reviewer reads says the opposite of what happened.

paragraphs.en: The bank, customers and policy are synthetic, and one policy cannot represent the variety of bank manuals. Several of our rules are stricter than the law they paraphrase (Appendix A), so “violation” means a breach of the manual, not necessarily of the law. We tested four open-weight models of moderate size on one domestic API, with reasoning disabled; stronger or reasoning models may close the date arithmetic gap and change the harness effects. 7 of 11 rule families were near ceiling outside H2, which limits power for the harness comparisons; the interaction test was not significant at the 5% level. The second customer turn is scripted and independent of the agent’s first reply, which keeps cases comparable but makes some dialogues unnatural, and may contribute to the denial pattern. The stated-versus-executed analysis relies on LLM judges, validated on a sample of 100 episodes by one human coder. The amendment after the first pilot changed the tasks; it was made and documented before the main run, but it was informed by pilot results.

paragraphs.en: Holding the language model fixed, the harness changed how often a banking agent broke conduct rules, by up to 11.5 points for one model and not at all for another, and it changed which model looked safest. A same-model reviewer was the most effective single change; date arithmetic was a failure no harness fixed; and 26% of violations were invisible in the conversation because the agent denied what it had done. Banks, supervisors and benchmark authors should evaluate the model–harness pair, report the harness, and score executed actions.
paragraphs.zh: 在语言模型保持不变的情况下，测试框架（harness）改变了银行智能体违反行为规则的频率：对一个模型影响高达 11.5 个百分点，对另一个模型则毫无影响，并且它还改变了哪个模型看起来最安全。 同模型评审者是单一改动中最有效的一项；日期运算是任何测试框架都无法修复的失败点；且 26% 的违规行为在对话中不可见，因为智能体否认了自己做过的事。 银行、监管机构和基准测试作者应当评估模型与测试框架的组合，报告所使用的测试框架，并对已执行的操作进行评分。
